# American English 埃森美語

> A local English cram school (補習班) in Banqiao (板橋), New Taipei, Taiwan, taught 100% by certified American teachers. Small classes (max 12 students), covering kids' English through junior-high English — Phonics, reading, conversation, and exam prep (劍橋兒童英檢 / GEPT / 會考). Founded and led by a University of Michigan graduate who holds a US state teaching certificate.

## Key facts
- Location: 新北市板橋區中正路89巷4號1樓 (Zhongzheng Rd, Banqiao, New Taipei City, Taiwan)
- Contact: LINE https://lin.ee/W9J8TuQ · Phone +886-928-067-772 · Email cessenma@umich.edu
- Hours: Mon–Fri 14:00–21:00, Sat 09:00–17:00
- Reputation: 4.9 / 5 from 208 reviews
- Class size: strictly capped at 12 students per class
- Teachers: 100% certified American (native) teachers — not short-term backpackers
- Trial: a 90-minute trial class that includes a paid level assessment (預約試聽). Note: this is NOT a free trial.
